title: Curious Calligraphy Cuttlefish
statement: This small, bright-eyed cuttlefish ripples its skin with looping, handwriting-like patterns that shift into new 'sentences' whenever a visitor lingers, as though it's trying to start a conversation. Between chats it tidies its sea-glass and shell collection into neat little libraries along the ledges of a sunken writing desk, glowing softly amber when something new drifts in.
